components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 4px; background: #88D498; color: #000; font: 700 14px/1.4 'DM Sans', sans-serif; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translate(4px, 4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #000; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #74B9FF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Input

narrative.overview: A warm reading surface meets the explicit geometry of a working desk. Black strokes and compact controls make actions easy to find; mint, sky, and butter mark action and state without suggesting unfinished AI behavior is live. The dashboard stays compact and practical, while document content remains calm to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Square geometry and tactile offset shadows

rules.name: The Honest Surface Rule
rules.body: Label samples and distinguish local page-session behavior from server capabilities.

rules.name: The Three Pastels Rule
rules.body: Use mint, sky, and butter; do not add gradients, glow, or glass.

dos: Do use the exact user-specified color values.
Do keep controls keyboard accessible and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't imply prototype files are uploaded, persisted, parsed, or analyzed.
Don't use gradients, glow, or glass effects.
